params.body:
Intelligence can now be bought on gentells.com the way Signal and Decode are: chosen on the sign-up form or the pricing page, then paid through the checkout.

- The sign-up form offers it beside the other three, two by two (Intelligence and its price do not fit a quarter of the form).
- The checkout no longer sends Intelligence to the contact form by name. It follows the offer's `contact` flag, as the pricing page and the form already did, so all three agree.
- The default for Intelligence is `contact: false`. The "By conversation" box on the Observatory's Settings page can still make any plan a conversation; a saved offer that has it ticked for Intelligence keeps it so until it is unticked there.

The matching default in the pipeline (`packages/core/plans.mjs`) is a separate pull request on gentells-pipeline.

Tests: the form offers Intelligence and sends it on to payment without granting the plan; pricing links to it; with `contact` ticked, pricing, form and checkout all go to the team. Full suite 537 of 538; the one failure is BuildStampTest, which needs a real checkout and fails in a worktree.
params.title: Intelligence is bought on the site like the other plans
